description: AION 2 gear Enhancement: the game's Enhancement window and how to guide a player through it, from docs/ENHANCEMENT.md (research record, 17 Oct 2026). One record per tab or topic. Every fact carries a status: confirmed (Miguel's in-game screenshots or the official character data), reported (guides agree, not tested yet) or unknown (nobody knows yet; pages say Not confirmed yet). No cost tables from client data: the pages only say to check the cost in game. The enhance chances, the failure bonus and the caps live in mechanics.json (enchant-rates, enchant-pity) and grades.json; the engine (enhancement-advisor.mjs) reads them from there.

tabs.name: Growth
tabs.purpose: Raise the enhance level. Each level adds stats.

tabs.name: Manastone
tabs.purpose: Engrave stones into the item's slots. Accessories take Soulstones.

tabs.name: Theostone
tabs.purpose: Engrave one Theostone, a proc effect, on the weapon.

tabs.name: Soul Binding
tabs.purpose: Raise the item's Soul Binding rate and its bonus lines.

tabs.name: Transfer
tabs.purpose: Move a built-up item's progress onto a better item for the same slot.

provenance.note: Five tabs in this order: Growth, Manastone, Theostone, Soul Binding, Transfer.

facts.text: Every step up to +10 succeeds.
Past +10 each step can fail. The Growth tab shows the chance of the next step.
Each failure adds 5 points to the chance of the next try at that step, so every step ends within a known number of tries.
A failure costs the attempt, never a level, and never breaks the item.
The failure bonus resets after a success.
Each try costs Enhance Stones and Kina. Check the cost in the Growth tab.
Extracting an item gives its Enhance Stones back, not the Kina.
Past +15, Amplified Enhancement on high item level gear uses Amplify Stones. Late game only.

provenance.note: Unique gloves +11 to +12: 50% success, Success Chance increases by 5.00% on failure, costs Enhance Stones and Kina, each level adds Defence and HP.

facts.text: The tab lists one line per slot, with Engrave and Auto Engrave.
Engraving never fails or breaks the item.
Auto Engrave repeats until a stat you choose appears, and can overwrite good lines.
Whether one Engrave fills one slot or rerolls them all.
Manastones are lost on Transfer. Put good stones only on gear you will keep.

facts.text: The tab lists your Weapon Theostones, with Combine and Engrave.
One Theostone per weapon. Engraving a new one replaces the old one.
Combine raises a stone's grade at a low chance: about 11% Rare to Epic, about 9% Epic to Unique.
How many stones go into one Combine.
Small value in PvE. Do it last, on the weapon you will keep.
The Theostone is lost on Transfer.

facts.text: Each item has a Soul Binding rate and 3 or 4 lines, each shown as now and max with a percent. At 100% a line is maxed.
Bind costs Kina and Soul Codices. Check the cost in the Soul Binding tab.
Each Bind raises the rate by a random amount and never lowers it. It slows near the cap. At 100% the item is locked.
Harmonise rerolls one line.
Reset rerolls every line and sets the rate back to 0. It needs a Soul Codex: Reset.
Fix weak lines before you Bind.
A Unique item at 100% can get an extra line. Late game.
Whether Soul Codices are the same item as the Soul Binding Book, and what Bind costs at higher rates.

facts.text: Gear Transfer moves from a Source Gear to the target and needs Gear Transfer Material.
It keeps the enhance level and the Soul Binding lines.
It loses the manastones, the Theostone and the extra line.
The material is made in Substance Morph.
Use it when a better item drops for the same slot. Check the preview first.
Exactly what the preview keeps.

records.label: What to enhance, and when
records.text: Enhancement is spent on Unique gear only. Unique gear starts at Lv 35; before that, save Enhance Stones, Kina and manastones. Epic, Rare and Common gear is never enhanced: a Unique piece replaces it. Belt and amulet are the exception: they use their own scrolls, not Enhance Stones, and go to +10 at every grade.

gates.question: Has the Daeva reached the level Unique gear starts at?
gates.no: Save and prepare: enhance nothing but the belt and amulet, and spend the time gathering materials and levelling your crafting, so by Lv 35 you can farm and craft enough to succeed.
gates.yes: Build the Unique pieces, one at a time.

gates.question: Is the piece Unique or better?
gates.no: Do not enhance it, not even with cheap stones. Replace it with a Unique piece.
gates.yes: It is a keeper: follow the steps below.

gates.question: Which piece first?
gates.answer: The weapon, then the guard, then the armour, then the accessories.

steps.title: Growth to +10
steps.text: Every step to +10 succeeds, and extraction gives the Enhance Stones back.

steps.title: Past +10, weapon then guard
steps.text: Each step can fail and costs a lot; the failure bonus caps the tries. Only the weapon and the guard.

steps.title: Soul Binding
steps.text: Reroll the lines that are weak for your role first, then Bind towards 100%.

steps.title: Manastones
steps.text: Top stones for your role in every slot. Only on keepers: Transfer loses them.

steps.title: Theostone
steps.text: One proc stone on the weapon you keep, last.

steps.title: Transfer
steps.text: When a better Unique drops for the slot: move the enhance level and Soul Binding across, then rebuild stones and Theostone.

exceptions.text: Belt and amulet use their own enhance scrolls, not Enhance Stones, and go to +10 at every grade.

prepare.text: Before Lv 35, gather all the time and level your crafting. By the time you are proficient you can farm the resources to build enough material to succeed.
prepare.why: Crafted Dragon Lord gear needs proficiency 55, is Unique, and has one more Soul Binding line than dungeon drops.

professions.name: Armorsmithing
professions.makes: Helm, pauldrons, breastplate, gloves, greaves, boots and cloak

professions.makes: Potions, serums, scrolls, Manastones and Soulstones

gather.text: Orichalcum Ore, wood, gems, herbs and Odyle (nearly every gear recipe needs Odyle). Every craft gives proficiency, success or not.

prepare.namesNote: Profession names differ between sources; these are the global client names. Check the in-game crafting menu.

provenance.note: Miguel, in game: do not recommend enhancing even Epic gear; Unique gear starts at Lv 35. Before then, gather materials and level crafting (armour, weapons, food, jewellery) so you can farm enough material to succeed.

records.label: The order to advise
steps: Before Lv 35 (no Unique gear yet): enhance nothing but the belt and amulet (their own scrolls). Save Enhance Stones, Kina and manastones; gather materials and level your crafting instead.
Epic, Rare and Common gear: never enhanced. A Unique piece replaces it.
Each Unique piece: Growth to +10 first (every step succeeds, the stones come back on extraction). The weapon first, then the guard, then the armour.
Past +10: the weapon, then the guard, one step at a time. The failure bonus means each step ends within a known number of tries.
Soul Binding on keepers: reroll weak lines first, then Bind.
Top manastones for your role, on keepers only.
Theostone on the weapon you will keep.
A better Unique for the same slot: Transfer, then rebuild the manastones and the Theostone.

provenance.note: Miguel, in game: no enhancing Epic; Unique gear from Lv 35.
